verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships an official MCP server, so a connected AI assistant can work inside the workspace from natural-language prompts such as "What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?". Documented actions include listing audits and evidence requests and adding comments, attachments and status updates, within admin-set limits. The caveats are that it needs a separate third-party assistant, and the documented actions cover only audits and evidence requests. The in-app AI Helpbot only answers questions from documentation and does not operate the product. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface, natural-language control of the wider product (controls, risks, policies, access reviews), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
